name: SWAG
description: Situations With Adversarial Generations (SWAG) is a dataset for grounded commonsense inference. Given a sentence from a video caption, models choose the most likely continuation from four options. Wrong answers were generated using adversarial filtering to be superficially plausible but semantically incorrect, making it harder than previous commonsense benchmarks.
reputation: Predecessor to HellaSwag; introduced adversarial filtering methodology; widely used in BERT-era research; human performance ~88%
notes: Introduced at EMNLP 2018. Contains 113,000 multiple-choice questions. BERT surpassed human performance shortly after its introduction (88% human vs BERT's 86.3%). Led to HellaSwag as a harder follow-up. Adversarial filtering (AF) methodology was influential for constructing harder benchmarks by filtering out easily identifiable wrong answers.
